environment.description: Ubuntu 22.04 ECS Fargate task with custom AppArmor profile loaded via ECS task definition appArmorProfile field. Profile name 'msg-processor-confined' uses deny rules with explicit path enumeration: allow write to /var/spool/processor/*.dat only when basename matches regex [a-f0-9\-]{36}\.dat (UUID format). All other file write operations including path traversal sequences are denied with audit logging. Profile includes 'deny /var/spool/processor/../** w' and 'deny /**/../** w' catch-all rules. The profile was generated using aa-genprof during load testing and manually hardened. Container runs as non-root uid 1000 with read-only root filesystem except /var/spool/processor/ tmpfs mount.
